description: Na₃P₁₁ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcn space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to five P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ atoms to form NaP₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent PNaP₃ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.03 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.31 Å. There are six inequivalent P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ sites. In the first P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ is bonded to one Na¹⁺ and three P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ atoms to form distorted PNaP₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two PNaP₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one PNa₃P₂ trigonal bipyramid, and corners with two equivalent NaP₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of P-P bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.23 Å. In the second P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na¹⁺ and three P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ atoms. There are a spread of P-P bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.25 Å. In the third P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and two equivalent P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ atoms to form corner-sharing PNa₃P₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ is bonded to one Na¹⁺ and three P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ atoms to form distorted PNaP₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two PNaP₃ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent PNa₃P₂ trigonal bipyramids. The P-P bond length is 2.25 Å. In the fifth P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and two P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ atoms. The P-P bond length is 2.16 Å. In the sixth P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na¹⁺ and three P⁰ᐧ²⁷⁻ atoms.
